audit: The Grand Line Archive — Stage 4B-1M Official Bandai inventory extraction and card-by-card reconciliation

upstream_catalogue.note: Snapshot is stale. Product-link counts are a cross-check only; they do not prove card-by-card completeness.

counting_rules: Each official Bandai language page is extracted independently. Every page entry is retained with its card number, name, rarity, type, product/printing label and exact image URL.
A printing identity is card number + official product/printing label + rarity + type + exact image URL. Repeated card numbers remain separate when their printing identity differs.
English EB-04 has no standalone English series page. Its 61 card numbers and 81 printing entries are assembled from official OP14-EB04 (40 entries) and OP15-EB04 (41 entries) pages.
Missing/unexpected card numbers compare official base-prefix numbers with the 2026-10-22 upstream card-number snapshot. Feed totals are not used as proof of completeness.
All extracted image URLs are source references; HTTP image loading and app proxy delivery have not yet been tested.

application_reconciliation_summary.OP-15: 119 base card numbers in both languages. OP15-075 El Thor and OP15-108 Nami are separate Best Selection Vol.6 product printings; 12 collection card images are documented.
application_reconciliation_summary.OP-18 English: 159 official printings: 119 base, 33 parallel variants and 7 special printings (6 SP, 1 TR). Three Stage 3 supplemental image IDs mismatch.
application_reconciliation_summary.OP-18 Japanese: 159 official printings: 119 base, 33 parallel variants and 7 special printings (6 SP, 1 TR). All image IDs match; one Japanese TR name and six SP rarity labels differ.
application_reconciliation_summary.EB-05 English: 96 official printings: 61 base, 27 parallel variants, 8 SP printings; 11 additional reprint card numbers. All 96 supplemental image IDs and metadata match.
application_reconciliation_summary.EB-05 Japanese: 96 official printings: 61 base, 27 parallel variants, 8 SP printings; 11 additional reprint card numbers. All 96 image IDs/names match; eight SP rarity labels are normalized.
application_reconciliation_summary.EB-04 English: No standalone English EB-04 page/product. 61 base numbers and 81 printings are split across OP14-EB04 and OP15-EB04.
application_reconciliation_summary.PRB: PRB-01: 319 printings / 111 card numbers / 1 PRB01-prefixed number. PRB-02: 316 printings / 173 card numbers / 18 PRB02-prefixed numbers.
